description: Composite, mixed-modality figure on one alloy: Fe-30Mn-1.2C-8Al low-density steel after 24 h at 600 °C. Panel (a) is a 3D atom probe tomography (APT) reconstruction whose legend defines purple = κ-carbide (L′1₂) at an iso-surface of 9 at.% C, with dots coloured C (teal), Mn (magenta) and Al (olive); the κ-carbide appears as elongated, roughly parallel rods/platelets inside an inclined needle-shaped volume, with [100]/[001] orientation triads at left and right, and a translucent cylinder highlights one selected rod. The middle panel (label partially cropped) is a 1D composition profile: y-axis "Concentration, at.%" from 0 to 70, x-axis "Distance, nm" from 0 to 100, with four curves labelled Fe (green), Mn (magenta), Al (blue) and C (red); boxed arrows along the top alternate regions labelled κ and γ, marking about eight periodic κ bands over the 100 nm traverse. Fe is low and C high inside the κ bands, Mn stays nearly flat, and Al is slightly enriched in κ. The third panel is a TEM micrograph with a 20 nm scale bar showing a fine checkerboard/tweed modulation of dark, roughly perpendicular lamellae. Together the panels demonstrate nanometre-scale, compositionally partitioned κ-carbide lamellae/rods in the aged austenite. Panel letters are partly cropped.

subfigures.description: 3D atom probe tomography reconstruction of an inclined needle-shaped analysis volume. Legend: purple = κ-carbide (L′1₂), iso-surface 9 at.% C; teal dot = C, magenta dot = Mn, olive dot = Al. Purple κ-carbide bodies are elongated, roughly parallel rods/platelets; two [100]/[001] orientation triads are drawn (left and right) and a translucent cylinder encloses a highlighted rod through the middle of the volume.

1D concentration profile of the aged steel: y-axis 'Concentration, at.%' 0–70 in 10 at.% ticks, x-axis 'Distance, nm' 0–100 in 20 nm ticks. Curves labelled Fe (green), Mn (magenta), Al (blue), C (red). Top arrows delimit alternating κ and γ regions, about eight κ bands across the traverse; Fe drops and C rises in κ, Mn is nearly flat around 22–25 at.%, Al around 15–18 at.%.

subfigures.description: Grayscale TEM micrograph with a black 20 nm scale bar in the upper right. It shows a modulated 'checkerboard'/tweed contrast of dark lamellae crossing roughly perpendicularly; individual lamellae are narrower than the 20 nm scale bar. observations.observation: Panel (a) legend states purple = κ-carbide (L′1₂) drawn as an iso-surface at 9 at.% C, and colours the atom dots as C (teal), Mn (magenta), Al (olive).
In the APT reconstruction the κ-carbide bodies are elongated, roughly parallel rods/platelets rather than equiaxed particles, and a translucent cylinder highlights a single rod.
Two crystallographic orientation triads labelled [100] and [001] are drawn on the APT volume, one at the left and one at the right side of panel (a).
The composition profile plots 'Concentration, at.%' (0–70) against 'Distance, nm' (0–100) with curves labelled Fe (green), Mn (magenta), Al (blue) and C (red).
Boxed arrows above the profile alternate regions labelled κ and γ, delimiting about eight periodic κ bands within the 100 nm traverse.

Across the profile, Fe is depleted and C enriched in the κ bands (Fe oscillating roughly between 45 and 60 at.%, C between roughly 5 and 15 at.%), whereas the Mn curve stays nearly flat near 22–25 at.%.
The TEM micrograph carries a 20 nm scale bar and shows a modulated checkerboard/tweed pattern of dark lamellae crossing at a high angle, with the individual lamellae narrower than the scale bar.
The colour coding differs between panels: the APT legend uses teal/magenta/olive for C/Mn/Al, while the profile curves use green/magenta/blue/red for Fe/Mn/Al/C.
The caption identifies the sample as Fe-30Mn-1.2C-8Al low-density steel after 24 h at 600 °C, synthesized after identifying suited compositions by the RAP process.

The caption describes panel (a) as a joint atom probe tomographic analysis and panel (b) as transmission electron microscopy (TEM) analysis of κ-carbides; the supplied crops show three images, so the middle profile panel is not separately named in the caption.

The citing text attributes pronounced strengthening during aging of the 30 wt.% Mn / ~8 wt.% Al system to the formation of nm-sized κ-carbides, with the intermediate 2–6 wt.% Al variants showing much smaller aging effects.
The citing text states that κ-carbides are thermally very stable at 600 °C and still prevail after 100 h heat treatment with only modest coarsening.
The citing text reports that after aging at 500–600 °C twinning is reduced and strain hardening is essentially associated with κ-carbide and solid-solution strengthening.

The citing text states that strengthening by regularly arranged nanosized κ-carbides involves Orowan bypassing of longitudinal rods of κ-carbides with subsequent dislocation-loop expansion, assisted by cross-slip and minor shearing.

unreadable_items: Panel letters of the second and third images are cropped: the profile panel and the TEM panel are both shown with a partially cut label (a '(b)'/'c' cannot be reliably distinguished), while the caption assigns TEM to panel (b)
No numeric axis values are printed inside the TEM micrograph other than the 20 nm scale bar
Small printed text in the APT panel (e.g. any additional annotation near the cylinder) is not legible at the supplied resolution
Individual peak positions/amplitudes of the composition profile are not printed as numbers; only tick values 0–70 at.% and 0–100 nm are readable
